evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund with automatic payments to all identifiable members. Brightline would separately pay up to $6 million in court-approved fees and expenses;
We can offer a $30 million class fund plus up to $5 million in court-approved fees and expenses, with any unawarded fees going to the class.

summary: Class counsel first proposed fees alongside class relief, and both amounts were negotiated before the class fund was settled. The transcript does not show a fee-for-relief trade, fee-driven conduct, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
